description: DB InfraGO OpenStation (railway station infrastructure data, Germany) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by DB InfraGO AG. OpenStation is described as the single source of truth for open data on passenger station infrastructure, following the European NeTEx and SIRI standards and the EU rail accessibility rules (TSI-PRM), served through an interface with a daily call limit of 7,500. Coverage: Germany, passenger stations of DB InfraGO. Formats and interfaces named: NeTEx, SIRI, API. Access is free of charge but needs registration. The licence is: CC0 (public domain dedication). Caveats: use needs registration and a subscription to a usage plan; the same data are also offered through Mobilithek, and the page does not list the fields. It can support station accessibility and rail network studies in Germany. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
